question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (AMD)

calls.reasoning: AMD guided Q3 FY2026 revenue to $13.0B ±$0.3B; consensus ~$13.06B. In recent quarters AMD has consistently beaten the guidance midpoint by ~3-7%: Q1'26 reached $10.25B vs a $9.5-10.1B range, and Q2'26 reached $11.54B, just above the top of a $10.9-11.5B range (+3%). Applying that pattern puts the median around $13.4-13.5B. The latest beat was the smallest, Lisa Su says the Helios ramp is only starting in Q3, and memory tightness may limit client/gaming. Above $14.2B would need a ~9% beat (~3%). No Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold market found.

Disputes were judgment: beat size (2.8% in Run 2 vs ~4% in Run 3) and width ($0.68B vs $0.85B). The Q2'26 guide midpoint ($11.2B) is consistent across the runs; earlier guide midpoints are from model memory, so the beat history has some uncertainty. I weighted the decaying beat trend and Su's 'beginning of ramp' comment against supply-chain strength and took a ~3.3% beat. Width uses beat-SD scaling with a small widening for sample size.
